A '''Dispersal Dish''' was a component used in [[Pacnorval Defense Systems, Limited]]'s [[Sd-77 sonic pistol]] and [[Sg-82 sonic rifle]]. The Dish was a conical shaped component that was located at the front of the weapon. The [[sound emitter]] was attached to the apex of the Dispersal Dish.<ref name="EGWT" />
